title: [Report Filename Manager] New app for configurable report output file names - Slice 651696 [vendor work]
summary: A new Report Filename Manager app enables administrators to configure dynamic file names for report output across all distribution routes using customizable patterns and placeholders.
key_points: New W1 Report Filename Manager app and test app for configurable report output file names
One pattern such as Invoice-[No.]-[Sell-to Customer No.] names output on print, preview, save, download, email, scheduled output, Report Inbox and financial reports
Placeholders are implemented through a Report Filename Placeholder interface and enum
No Base Application code changes; uses platform and Base Application events, with four marked stand-ins where events are missing
Setup reads compiled metadata only, so it behaves the same in an empty company
